body.name: Complete-normal efficient cross-fitted estimator
body.construction:
For each training complement of \(I_\ell\), estimate the retained propensities and one-step regressions by \(\widehat p^{-\ell}\) and \(\widehat m^{-\ell}\), and construct
\[
\widehat S_i^{-\ell}=S^{\mathrm{per}}(O_i;\widehat\eta^{-\ell}),
\qquad \widehat\eta^{-\ell}=(\widehat p^{-\ell},\widehat m^{-\ell}).
\]
Using training-sample cell averages, form the symmetrized conditional moments
\[
\widehat K^{-\ell}(x)=
\widehat E_{-\ell}[\widehat S^{-\ell}\widehat S^{-\ell\prime}\mid X=x],
\qquad
\widehat r^{-\ell}(x)=
\widehat E_{-\ell}[\widehat S^{-\ell}\widehat\psi^{0,-\ell}\mid X=x],
\]
where
\[
\widehat\psi^{0,-\ell}
=\sum_{k=(g,t)\in\mathcal K}\omega_k
\left\{\widehat R_{k,c_0(k)}^{-\ell}
-\widehat\theta_k^{-\ell}\frac{\mathbf 1_{g,1}}{\widehat\pi_{g,1}^{-\ell}}\right\},
\]
and the preliminary ratios \(\widehat\theta_k^{-\ell}\) and shares \(\widehat\pi_{g,1}^{-\ell}\) are computed on the training complement.  Threshold the eigenvalues of \(\widehat K^{-\ell}(x)\) at \(\tau_n\), form the Moore--Penrose inverse of the retained part \(\widehat K^{-\ell}_\tau(x)\), and set
\[
\widehat\alpha^{-\ell}(x)=
\{\widehat K^{-\ell}_\tau(x)\}^{\dagger}\widehat r^{-\ell}(x).
\]
For \(i\in I_\ell\), evaluate the cross-fitted raw ratio pseudo-outcomes \(\widehat R_i\) and the signal \(\widehat S_i^{-\ell}\), and return
\[
\widehat\tau_{\mathrm{eff}}
=\frac1n\sum_{\ell=1}^L\sum_{i\in I_\ell}
\left\{
\sum_{k\in\mathcal K}\omega_k\widehat R_{i,k,c_0(k)}
-\widehat\alpha^{-\ell}(X_i)'\widehat S_i^{-\ell}
\right\}.
\]
Let \(\widehat\theta_k=n^{-1}\sum_{\ell}\sum_{i\in I_\ell}\widehat R_{i,k,c_0(k)}\) and \(\widehat\pi_{g,1}=n^{-1}\sum_i\mathbf 1\{G_i=g,S_i=1\}\).  For \(i\in I_\ell\), define
\[
\widehat\phi_i=
\sum_{k=(g,t)\in\mathcal K}\omega_k
\left\{\widehat R_{i,k,c_0(k)}
-\widehat\theta_k\frac{\mathbf 1\{G_i=g,S_i=1\}}{\widehat\pi_{g,1}}\right\}
-\widehat\alpha^{-\ell}(X_i)'\widehat S_i^{-\ell},
\]
\[
\widehat V_{\mathrm{eff}}
=\frac1n\sum_{i=1}^n(\widehat\phi_i-\overline{\widehat\phi})^2,
\qquad
\overline{\widehat\phi}=\frac1n\sum_{i=1}^n\widehat\phi_i,
\]
and report the already declared Wald interval \(\mathrm{CI}_{1-\alpha}\).
